description: i18n setup with react-i18next, English and Hindi translations, language selector in Settings
steps: Install react-i18next and i18next: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm install react-i18next i18next
Create src/i18n/index.ts - i18next configuration with fallbackLng 'en', interpolation escapeValue false, resources loaded from locale files. Export the initialized i18n instance.

Create src/i18n/locales/en.json - English strings covering: auth (sign_in, sign_up, email, password, full_name, forgot_password, or_separator, continue_google, no_account, have_account), feed (for_you, following, nothing_yet, be_first, create_post, discover_people), profile (edit_profile, followers, following_label, posts), settings (settings, account, privacy, your_data, sign_out, language, select_language), common (loading, error, try_again, save, cancel, delete, search)
Create src/i18n/locales/hi.json - Hindi translations for all the same keys
Update src/main.tsx - import the i18n config (import '@/i18n') before the app renders to initialize i18next
Update src/pages/Auth.tsx - use useTranslation() hook for key UI strings (button labels, placeholders, tab labels)
Update src/pages/Feed.tsx - use useTranslation() for tab labels (For you, Following) and empty state text
Update src/pages/Settings.tsx - add a Language section with a selector that calls i18n.changeLanguage(). Show current language. Options: English, Hindi. Persist choice in localStorage.
acceptance_criteria: i18next is configured with en and hi locales
Feed page tab labels use translations
Settings page has a language selector that changes the app language
verification: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run build
Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run test
findings: i18next and react-i18next installed successfully. i18n config initializes synchronously with inline resources. The Feed.tsx tab map originally used variable name 't' which collided with useTranslation's t function - renamed to 'item'. All 33 existing tests pass. Build produces no errors.
